items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bromley and Big Daddy, I can’t remember, but you know all that stuff.

ctx.x: Look at Bird. Bird goes to Max Roach’s house, he takes off all his clothes - Max had got a full length mirror in the bathroom - he calls Max. He says, “Max, come here! Look! Look!” And he said, “Max, I’ve used this thing up!” pointing to the body. Bird was brilliant. Miles was brilliant. The intuitive thing, but you can always understand something beneath your level. But something else, you have to pay the price here for whatever you want. You can have whatever you want, you just gotta pay for it. And if you want…
